description: I'm a BCA student and developer interested in AI, web development, UI/UX, graphic design, and space exploration. I enjoy turning ideas into creative, interactive digital experiences. Our goal is to build an immersive Moon and Mars exploration archive that brings forgotten NASA equipment and its stories to life. Looking for passionate teammates skilled in astronomy, space research, 3D design, animation, data visualization, and storytelling. Let's build something impactful!
